model: SingleBankSTMD, one bank of eight equal-speed directions (8x1)
observation: Stationary base B, 320x320 RGB at 20 Hz, 84x84 degree FoV
correct: accepted candidate, visible insect, localization ray transverse error < 5% of target range
start_distance_accuracy: unweighted average of per-run visible-frame accuracy, each run one observation
actual_distance_accuracy: visible frames pooled from 20 independent runs per initial condition into 10–25 cm and 25 cm actual-range bins, through 4 m; bin contributions vary
target: idealized dark disk; inertial obstacle-avoiding random flight
scoring: ground truth used only for evaluation, not detector input
